comments: cef1b57b: This section of the code is responsible for generating a report that lists all divisions along with their respective counts of delinquent records.
272e8f5e: Iterate through the divisions and display their names and total delinquency counts.
76d143f6: End of the report generation routine.
1bab6aff: Header formatting for the totals page, including column titles.
465cd7cd: Print blank lines until the end of the page to ensure footer positioning.
8a3b9e11: Retrieve the division's delinquency total if it exists and display it.
53d25a43: Check if the output device is a CRT before prompting the user.
cc32eea3: Prompt the user to continue or quit; handle timeout and user exit.
d9db2bd8: Reset the page counter when the division changes.
30874f87: Print the report header with the report type, date, and page number.
5bdde1f2: For event date sorting, format the header to include specific columns.
68815e51: For non-event date sorting, adjust the header to include relevant columns.
4ce22aa6: Column headers for the various sections of the report.
133eeb99: For non-physician sorted reports, include physician name and optionally status and total days columns.
8c23a080: For physician sorted reports, adjust columns to include type, status, and total days.
fcbad9ca: End of the header printing routine.
87a9399b: Clean up and kill all variables used in the report generation to free up memory.
a4464200: Further clean up by killing additional variables and temporary globals.
3018ce56: Kill remaining variables and close any open devices or files.
560a45d4: Call a routine to properly close out the report generation process.
bb463018: For physician summaries, display the count if no more records exist for the current physician.
21a51925: For service summaries, display the count if no more records exist for the current service provider.
c45cbcd8: Display the subtotal count for a service if no more records exist within the service.
365ada6b: End of the service summary routine.
47b5f6c5: Display the abbreviated type of document if it exists.
428facb2: For detailed reports, display the status of the document if applicable.
25e247ab: Display the total number of days calculated for the document.
3426d723: End of the document type and status display routine.
